parameters.name: XTURFECErrors
parameters.description: Total number of FEC errors detected (FEC-C as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.1}}). Note: If the parameter is implemented but no value is available, its value MUST be 4294967295 (the maximum for its data type).

parameters.name: XTUCFECErrors
parameters.description: Total number of FEC errors detected by the ATU-C (FEC-CFE as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.1}}). Note: If the parameter is implemented but no value is available, its value MUST be 4294967295 (the maximum for its data type).

parameters.name: XTURHECErrors
parameters.description: Total number of HEC errors detected (HEC-P as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.1}}). Note: If the parameter is implemented but no value is available, its value MUST be 4294967295 (the maximum for its data type).

parameters.name: XTUCHECErrors
parameters.description: Total number of HEC errors detected by the ATU-C (HEC-PFE as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.1}}). Note: If the parameter is implemented but no value is available, its value MUST be 4294967295 (the maximum for its data type).

parameters.name: XTURCRCErrors
parameters.description: Total number of CRC errors detected (CV-C as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.1}}). Note: If the parameter is implemented but no value is available, its value MUST be 4294967295 (the maximum for its data type).

parameters.name: XTUCCRCErrors
parameters.description: Total number of CRC errors detected by the ATU-C (CV-CFE as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.1}}). Note: If the parameter is implemented but no value is available, its value MUST be 4294967295 (the maximum for its data type).

object.description: This object contains DSL channel total statistics {{bibref|G.997.1}}. Note: The {{object}} parameters SHOULD NOT be reset when the interface statistics are reset via an interface disable / enable cycle.
